We are sorry to hear that Robert Poole has gone to live in Reading. He wishes to remain a member of Belgrave and will get down to race for us whenever he can.
The individual winner was M.Geary of the College but the Bels filled second and third places with Robert Poole and John Hamilton. There were 34 boys in the race - more than half of them being Bels.
The Boys race held in conjunction was won by Robert Poole in 16:26 which put him in 4th place in the overall race; quite a feat for a 14 year old.

Bob Poole was 3rd in an all Oxfordshire boys race recently and is upholding the name of Belgrave in this locality. There are many others, all eagerly trying to make their marks, and to these we would repeat the old advice once again.

Cliff Calderwood looked as if he would make the scoring five when John Hamilton faded away but he was outrun by Nigel Bacon and Robert Poole who clinched third place for Belgrave in a close team result.

This was our first trip to this venue and, on unfamiliar country, Vic Butcher, Nigel Bacon & Robert Poole all went off course. The race was a mixed youths & boys event and Bill Curtin was the first boy to finish.
Hot favourite, Bill Curtin, had no difficulty in taking away the title from last year's winner Bob Poole. Our course was very muddy in parts and the "Avenue" was flooded.
Robert Poole travelled down from Reading and finished eighth but Vic Butcher and Mick Harvey were not at their best and we had to be contant with 4th place.
Robert Poole recently helped his school relay team to success in a road relay organised by Reading A.C. - Bob getting second fastest of the day.
